construction_pipeline.limits: Payload delivery, accepted output and saved/read-back plans are distinct observations, not causal win-rate evidence. Missing calibration is pending, not a service failure.

s_readiness.limits: Shadow is not brain delivery. Low trust and failed sign audit suppress facts without changing mandatory computation or old ranking.

s_combat_rank.limits: S tie ranking is conditional on paired samples, sign audit and existing model trust; not game calibration or causal benefit.

build_ranking.limits: Shadow choices do not require override reasons. Pending card targets and first shop actions do not certify complete plans or causal benefit.

computation.scope: B2/B3 computation service failures; degradation permits continuation, not fault resolution.

adaptive.admission: accepted source; runtime mode=on; never auto-enable
adaptive.limits: Shadow estimates and actual on-mode sample work are separate. On-mode cannot observe full-run agreement; no elapsed-time saving or game benefit inferred.

brain.decision_use: unknown; delivery is not evidence of reasoning or a fixed DPR weight
